tables.title: Where you fight it
rows: 咆哮树林、吟唱者草甸、多雨平原、轰鸣虫壳地、安眠丘陵、冰封高地、蜜脾原野

tables.title: Moves
rows: Opens the combo when you're close、at most once every 6 秒onds、and the right swipe always follows the left whether or not it hit. Each swing lunges forward as it lands、so roll sideways instead of backpedaling.
The combo's third hit keeps tracking you until the fist comes down、hits harder than the swipes、starts a redstone ripple a short way in front of it.
An expanding ring from the fist slam、the fist crush that damages you、sets you Burned. Jump or roll through it; each ring only hits you once.

When you're far away it glows、spits three redstone bolts in quick succession across a 60 degree fan. They arc in、explode on impact for 10% of your max health as 爆炸 damage、leave you Burned、so keep strafing.
A wind-up、a burst of steam telegraph it、then it barrels at you for up to 3 秒onds at greatly boosted speed. It turns very slowly once moving、so a late sidestep works、and a hit launches you a long way.
Comes only after a charge that connects: both fists slam down、send out two redstone ripples. Dodge the charge、you skip it entirely.

It flashes、fires four or five cores that land on fixed spots in the arena. Each core shoots three rounds of four straight bolts、then bursts、and cores can't be hit、so stay off their firing lines、clear out before they pop.
A scream signals it、and 5 to 7 Redstone Cubes spawn around the arena、up to 15 alive at once. Each summoned cube is worth 20 souls.
